producer_report.summary: Root cause: the reading gate had no required verification method for subjective quality. A request could say a page must be clear to a newcomer, and a reading was accepted with no criterion saying how that is judged. Jobs 20261014-163844-c2kt and 20261015-064153-wekz then failed or asked the user. I fixed it at the gate. `check_subjective_method(reading, request)` is in surveys.rs, with one new `step!` line at the end of `refusing_check`. It reads only `plain_request_prose(request)`, so Athena's generated root-cause lines, quotes, example lists, paths and fenced code never trigger it. A line triggers when it holds a page/guide/report-type noun (`VISIBLE_NOUNS`) and either a self-subjective phrase (newcomer, easy to follow/understand/read, understandable) or a clarity phrase (how clear, clear to/for, clarity) beside a person word (newcomer, beginner, first-time, reader, and so on). The reading is then accepted only if one criterion of kind behavior names an independent model reader, a persona, a 1-to-5 scale and a pass threshold. The user's own `outcome-check` default sentence ("a rating below 4 of 5") passes word for word. The error quotes the line, lists the missing parts and says to state the method before the build. Also added: unit tests in reading.rs; 16 refusal-corpus cases with six new form tags (the defaults.toml sentence is read by `include_str!`); a declared-share test; a tenth `READING_RULES` line in briefs.rs; a CHANGELOG entry; and case C8 in defaults-loop.md. I did not run the full `cargo test` and could not run the replay. Nothing from the dropped c2kt and wekz candidates was redone.

criteria_check.criterion: Expected 5% of newly refused readings: the rule refuses more readings and the higher refusal rate is intended, but it triggers only on subjective-quality wording, so it must not refuse readings of ordinary code requests.
criteria_check.evidence: The trigger needs a visible noun and subjective wording on the same plain-prose line. Accepted cases and tests cover ordinary requests: refactor the page renderer, clear the cache, call site readable, machine-readable output, clarity of the verifier report, report clear to the maintainer, quoted and fenced mentions, and generated root-cause lines. All 1197 existing athena-core tests passed unchanged, and the drain and steward tests passed. The doc comment, the CHANGELOG item and `subjective_method_refusal_is_declared_intended` declare "expected 5% of newly refused readings" as an estimate. I could not run the replay (records are not in the working copy).

open_issues: Open question for the user: should the gate later require the stated pass threshold to be at least 4, as the outcome-check default says? It currently accepts any threshold from 1 to 5.

The 5% share is an estimate; the replay at verification measures it. A request that mentions a `reader` (Athena's own role) beside a report and the word clarity could be refused falsely. I did not narrow the person list; `SUBJECTIVE_PEOPLE` is the extension point.
The corpus case for job 20261015-064153-wekz is rebuilt from the brief's described shape, not from a recorded request, and its source string says so.
mistakes: The first draft of the scale matcher had a mixed `&&`/`||` expression, which I rewrote clearly before any test ran.
The first CHANGELOG-bound size comment in briefs.rs said "about 2920" without measurement. I corrected it to 2906, computed from the line length, and marked it an estimate.
learnings: `has_phrase` treats a hyphen as a word boundary, so a bare `readable` would match `machine-readable` and `human-readable`.
`plain_request_prose` already drops Athena's generated root-cause lines when `ROOT_CAUSE_ANCHOR` is present, so a root-cause request that quotes an outcome needs no special case.
The words `operator` and `lease` are banned, so test requests that need a person word use `maintainer`.
The reader brief's rules section was about 2718 bytes before this change and is about 2906 after. Its bound was raised from 2750 to 3000.
Bash is limited to cargo/git/ls/chmod/mv/rm, so test output cannot be piped through grep or tail. Use `cargo test -q` and read the Grep tool output.
desires: A way to run the replay of accepted readings locally, to measure the refusal share instead of estimating it.
Permission to pipe test output through grep, to cut the very long `cargo test` output.
